name: Kurano Ema
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c20865]Kazuya's[/url] younger sister she's the twin sister of [url=http://vndb.org/c10103]Yae[/url]. The most demure of Kazuya's sisters she relies on him more than any of the others. She's a first-year student in high school. She takes the role of supporting Kazuya and Yae in the kitchen.

She has the exact same eye color as her twin sister Yae.
